stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - «Seit dem Sommer habe ich überlegt, was das Beste für unser Land ist», sagt Bundesrat Parmelin zum Rücktritt

en.title: LIVE-TICKER - "Since summer I have been thinking about what is best for our country," says Federal Councillor Parmelin on his resignation
en.summary: Guy Parmelin, Switzerland's economic minister, has announced his definitive resignation after speculation about his departure had circulated for some time.

stories.title: Rücktritt aus dem Bundesrat – Guy Parmelin: «Niemand ist unersetzlich»

en.title: Resignation from Federal Council - Guy Parmelin: "Nobody is irreplaceable"
en.summary: The 66-year-old economic minister Guy Parmelin is stepping down at the end of the year to make way for new leadership.

stories.title: PODCAST «NZZ WEEKEND» - «Die Welt ist voll von talentierten Versagern», sagt Harald Schmidt

en.title: PODCAST "NZZ WEEKEND" - "The world is full of talented failures," says Harald Schmidt
en.summary: Cabaret performer and entertainer Harald Schmidt discusses his career bringing late-night television to Germany and his continued work at age 69.

stories.title: Guy Parmelin tritt zurück – Vom Alibi-Kandidaten zum Staatsmann – Guy Parmelin im Bundesrat

en.title: Guy Parmelin resigns - From token candidate to statesman - Guy Parmelin in the Federal Council
en.summary: Guy Parmelin began his role with limited expectations but developed into a respected figure known for his collegial and pragmatic approach.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Guy Parmelin tritt zurück – mit ihm verliert die Schweiz ihren besten Krisenminister

en.title: COMMENTARY - Guy Parmelin steps down – Switzerland loses its best crisis minister
en.summary: Guy Parmelin, who served as Economics Minister and Federal President, is stepping down from his position. The commentary praises his steady approach to policy and leadership during his tenure.

stories.title: "Le feu sacré n'est plus aussi sacré": Guy Parmelin annonce sa démission du Conseil fédéral

en.title: "The sacred fire is no longer as sacred": Guy Parmelin announces his resignation from the Federal Council
en.summary: Guy Parmelin has announced his resignation from the Federal Council. The headline references his statement about diminishing passion for the role.

stories.title: En direct – Guy Parmelin annonce son départ du Conseil fédéral

en.title: Live – Guy Parmelin announces his departure from the Federal Council
en.summary: Economics Minister Guy Parmelin will leave the Federal Council at the end of December following his year as President of the Confederation.

stories.title: Jusqu'à 900'000 Suisses veulent changer d'assurance maladie, selon un sondage de Deloitte

en.title: Between 600,000 and 900,000 Swiss want to change health insurance, according to a Deloitte survey
en.summary: A Deloitte survey estimates that 600,000 to 900,000 Swiss people plan to switch health insurers due to announced premium increases for 2027. About a quarter of respondents reported difficulty paying premiums.

stories.title: Elon Musk rappelé à Washington pour plancher sur les guerres du futur

en.title: Elon Musk recalled to Washington to work on future wars
en.summary: Elon Musk is returning to the Trump administration to participate in a committee identifying technologies and weapons needed for future U.S. military conflicts, announced Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

stories.title: Jusqu’à 900 000 Suisses vont changer d’assurance maladie après la nouvelle hausse des primes, selon Deloitte

en.title: Up to 900,000 Swiss to change health insurance following new premium increase, according to Deloitte
en.summary: A projected 5 percent increase in health insurance premiums for 2027 is expected to prompt between 600,000 and 900,000 Swiss residents to switch insurers, with over half the population now reviewing policies annually.

stories.title: Deux tiers des Suisses s’opposent à l’achat des F-35, selon un sondage de l’institut Leewas

en.title: Two-thirds of Swiss oppose F-35 purchase, according to Leewas institute poll
en.summary: A survey of 10,000 people found that 65% of Swiss respondents oppose purchasing American F-35 fighter jets, while 28% support the acquisition. Opposition spans all age groups, with stronger rejection among Socialist and Green party supporters.

stories.title: De retour au sein de l'administration Trump, Elon Musk planchera sur les futures guerres des Etats-Unis

en.title: Back within Trump administration, Elon Musk will work on future wars of the United States
en.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced that Elon Musk will join a committee tasked with identifying the technologies and weapons the United States will need for future conflicts.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN WIRTSCHAFT - Inflation im Euro-Raum auf Drei-Jahres-Hoch +++ Warenhauskonzern Galeria stellt erneut einen Insolvenzantrag

en.title: BUSINESS NEWS - Inflation in euro zone at three-year high +++ Department store group Galeria files for insolvency again
en.summary: Eurozone inflation reached a three-year high, while department store operator Galeria filed for insolvency for another time.

stories.title: DIE NEUESTEN ENTWICKLUNGEN - Zollverhandlungen Schweiz – USA: Donald Trump greift die Schweiz erneut an und sagt: «Ich will nicht 40 Milliarden Dollar im Jahr verlieren für eure Uhren»

en.title: Latest Developments - Tariff Negotiations Switzerland – USA: Donald Trump Attacks Switzerland Again and Says: "I Don't Want to Lose 40 Billion Dollars a Year for Your Watches"
en.summary: Switzerland reached a provisional tariff agreement with the US in November, though final negotiations continue. After the Supreme Court ruled Trump's earlier tariffs unlawful in February, the US implemented new tariffs under different legal authority.

stories.title: Mario Draghi fordert in Zürich eine stärkere europäische Integration: «Das alte Wachstumsmodell funktioniert nicht mehr»

en.title: Mario Draghi calls for stronger European integration in Zurich: "The old growth model no longer works"
en.summary: Former European Central Bank President Mario Draghi addressed ETH Zurich, arguing that Europe must unlock new sources of growth and outlining how this could be achieved through stronger integration.

stories.title: Open AI ist eine Billion Dollar wert – doch in Zürich hat sich der Konzern nun als Kleinfirma eingetragen

en.title: Open AI is worth one trillion dollars – but in Zurich it registered as a small company
en.summary: Despite hopes that OpenAI and Anthropic could grow to the scale of Meta or Google, an analysis of job postings and business registrations shows both companies have experienced minimal growth in Switzerland.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - Das Swissair-Grounding und die Schweiz: «Das Misstrauen gegenüber der Wirtschaftselite ist bis heute nicht verschwunden»

en.title: INTERVIEW - The Swissair collapse and Switzerland: "Mistrust of the business elite has not disappeared to this day"
en.summary: Economic historian Tobias Straumann describes Swissair's October 2, 2001 collapse as emblematic of Switzerland's broader economic decline, resulting in a lasting division between the public and the business establishment.
